items.summary: Microsoft Teams will let users report suspicious guest invitations for security concerns starting late November 2026. Reports go to IT admins via the Teams admin center. No action is needed if "Report a security concern" is already enabled in messaging policies, which control this feature.

Rollout starts late November 2026 for Targeted Release and early December 2026 for General Availability. No admin action is required.

items.summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will tag promotional emails as “promotions” and can auto-move them to a Promotions folder, learning from user actions. Public preview starts mid-April 2026; general rollout begins late July 2026. Admins control settings; users can train the system by moving messages.

items.title: MC1479513: Outlook: Insert Symbols
items.summary: Starting mid-October 2026, Outlook will roll out the ability to insert symbols into emails via the Insert tab, completing by late January 2027. This feature affects users on new Outlook for Windows and web, requires no admin action, and enhances message composition with special characters.

items.summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will reduce email reply notifications by only sending alerts for direct replies, @mentions, and new posts, not for all conversation replies. The update rolls out globally from September to November 2026, requires no action, and keeps existing notification settings unchanged.

items.summary: Microsoft SharePoint will enhance data access governance reports and site access reviews starting late November 2026, giving admins better control to identify data risks, prioritize sites, direct review requests, and track email delivery. items.summary: Microsoft Teams will end support for iOS 17 and iPadOS 17 starting mid-December 2026, requiring iOS/iPadOS 18 or later for new releases. items.summary: Starting mid-November 2026, Microsoft Entra ID will add risk-based CAPTCHA verification for SMS and voice MFA to prevent automated fraud. Some users may need to complete CAPTCHA before receiving codes or calls. Administrators should prepare users, ensure network readiness, and promote phishing-resistant methods.

items.summary: Starting February 2027, the minimum iOS/iPadOS and macOS Company Portal version will be v5.2608.0. Most users update automatically; those with app installation blocked may need manual updates. Prepare by informing helpdesk and pushing updates if device restrictions are enabled.
